## Faultline alert intake
Faultline's notifier POSTs every alert event (CREATED, ESCALATED, RESOLVED) here, signed with HMAC-SHA256.

1. Verify the signature and reject timestamps older than 300 s (replays).
2. Dedupe by `event_id`: delivery is at-least-once, so retries arrive twice.
3. Route to people: page on CRITICAL, open an incident on HIGH, close on RESOLVED.

Connect Slack, PagerDuty or Jira credentials to the hand-off node.
